answered.sql: SELECT T1.name FROM Methodologies AS T1 JOIN Project_Managers_Methodologies AS T2 ON T1.methodology_id = T2.methodology_id GROUP BY T2.methodology_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.project_manager_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Project_Managers)
